other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: For adversarial the 3.1 'Report today' cell (L83) reads 'contract, but filename not fixed', so the P0 smoke run has no known existing report file for step 3 or the step-4 `test -s`, and the P0 check cannot be executed as written.

other_new_defects.quote: Every command whose row names an unattended-mode change in P1-P3 also gains the `## Unattended mode` section
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: Adversarial, cleanup-audit and index-repo rows name only a filename/location fix, so an implementer following this rule adds no section, but AC-1.1 (L195) requires the section for every row naming a P1 change and fails.

other_new_defects.quote: so the worker takes the single such file created after dispatch
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: With two workflow workers (or any other package created concurrently) in the shared worktree there is no single file, and the worker may report another worker's return-contract.yaml; the rule gives no way to identify its own.
